section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1997
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1997 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) 1.3.5.2 A comparative statement on number of Registered Motor Vehicles, Population, accidents, casualties therein and rate of accidents per thousand vehicle and rate of vehicles per '000' population during 1996 for selected countries revealed that India has low share of only 37 vehicles per thousand persons as compared to 655 and 617 vehicles in Switzerland and Austria respectively. In case of rate of accidents per thousand vehicles too, our country rated at 8.1 as compared to 27.1 in Hongkong.
